summary.one_liner: A macOS desktop Pomodoro timer app built with Electron that tracks work intervals and sends desktop notifications.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Pomodoro Technique timer for macOS, using 25-minute work intervals separated by short breaks. Its listed features are tracking pomodoro intervals, desktop notifications, and configurable interval settings. The README includes a developer section with clone, npm install, and build steps. It also has a link to the latest release (version 0.0.6 for macOS). The project is licensed under GNU GPL.
use_cases: tracking pomodoro work intervals on a Mac
getting desktop alerts when a break is due
customizing work and break interval lengths
building a Pomodoro timer app from source
notable: Pomodoro timer packaged as a macOS desktop app
Dev scripts for serving locally and building a macOS build
caveats: README lists only macOS as a supported platform
Thin documentation; no screenshots or detailed usage guide
Only one release version (0.0.6) is listed in the README
